summary: Qeshm International Airport (GSM/OIKQ) serves Qeshm Island, the largest island in the Persian Gulf and part of Iran's Free Trade Zone in Hormozgan Province. Located near the town of Dayrestan on the island's southern side, it provides the main air link between Qeshm and mainland cities including Tehran and Bandar Abbas. The airport supports both domestic flights and charter operations catering to the island's growing tourism, particularly visitors exploring the Qeshm UNESCO Global Geopark.
faqs:
Q: Where is Qeshm International Airport located?
A: It is situated on the southern part of Qeshm Island, near the town of Dayrestan, in Hormozgan Province, Iran.

Q: Does the airport offer international flights?
A: The airport primarily handles domestic flights, though it has the infrastructure for international charters and serves as a gateway to the Qeshm Free Trade Zone.

Q: What are the main destinations served from Qeshm?
A: Domestic routes connect Qeshm mainly with Tehran (Mehrabad and Imam Khomeini airports) and Bandar Abbas on the mainland.

Q: Are there duty-free shops or trade zone benefits at the airport?
A: As Qeshm is an Iranian free trade zone, travelers can take advantage of favorable customs regulations for goods purchased on the island.
transport_tips: The airport is roughly 60 km from Qeshm City, so allow at least 90 minutes for the drive, especially given variable road conditions on the island. Taxis and private transfers are the most reliable way to reach the terminal from the main towns. Rental cars are available on the island and can be arranged in advance for easier exploration of Qeshm's geopark sites.
local_tip: Schedule your flights for daytime arrival if possible — the drive from the airport crosses scenic coastal and desert terrain, and arriving in daylight lets you appreciate Qeshm's distinctive landscapes before reaching your hotel.
